headline: Working through Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, in logical order and with no fixed date. They are not done: most aspects haven't been tested with a real question, and Andhra Pradesh finance is thin. Today's first hand-marked test scored 157 of 179, before the fixes. New documents are going into search on the PC, and the aspect questions start right after.

usage.weekly_rule: Stops at 18% in total until you say continue

decisions: Weekly limit: work stops at 18% in total, as you asked, and I'll write a report here when it does. It restarts only when you say continue.

Start a fresh session when convenient. This one has grown large, so each step costs more of your limits. A new session reading the handoff would cost far less. Scheduled checks would need setting up again in it, which it can do itself.
Keep the app open and the PC awake. Scheduled reports only run while this session is open, and PC jobs stop if the PC sleeps.

A person should check the rates. All exact records are marked unreviewed. First: Andhra Pradesh's enhanced relief. The order says "over and above SDRF norms", and I recorded paddy's Rs.25,000 as the total paid, not as added to Rs.17,000.
Spot-check my marks if you can. I marked the 179 answers myself, and read native-language answers only to about 520 characters.
next: PC finishes building search for the new documents, then asks all 136 aspect questions for Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu. Groq takes over if Gemini's free limit runs out.
Read every answer by hand and mark it on the grid above.
For each wrong or empty answer: find the document, enter the exact rate after reading it, or fix the engine with a test.

Open data gaps to chase next: Andhra Pradesh land records and tenancy, solar pumps, electricity duty rate, guideline values, tax arrears, state loans. Tamil Nadu crop insurance dates, electricity tax, women's registration concession and the paddy incentive, from official copies.
Dates on rules, starting with a "replaced by" field on orders.
issues: Andhra Pradesh finance is thin: 288 passages before today's documents are built in, and nothing yet on electricity duty, guideline values, tax arrears or women's concessions.
Failed downloads: the Andhra Pradesh Socio Economic Survey, the power tariff note, Gender Budget and some horticulture files. Other routes still to try.
Tamil Nadu's horticulture site is slow, about 7 minutes a file, so 15 orders are downloading separately and go in a later build.
Two sites have certificate problems: apagrisnet.gov.in and ctd.tn.gov.in. I don't bypass those checks, so other sources are needed.
Groq answers need watching. One backup answer invented steps. Code now refuses uncited steps, but only one re-test has run.
Press-only figures aren't entered. Paddy MSP Rs.2,441 for 2026-27 and Tamil Nadu's incentive are reported by the press. Official copies are needed first.
No full re-run since the fixes, so the 157 of 179 doesn't show their effect yet.
No Nvidia GPU on this PC. It has Intel Arc graphics, 16 GB of RAM and a CPU-only PyTorch, so builds and local models run on the CPU for now.

log.text: Monitoring station set up on this page, with the architecture, diagrams and techniques updated. Today: first hand-marked test, 157 of 179 good, marked by me before the fixes. Added 36 exact rates across Andhra Pradesh deeds, vehicle tax and relief, Tamil Nadu vehicle tax and Chennai profession tax, all unreviewed. Engine: 3 checks added, 231 code tests pass. Listed 18,441 Andhra Pradesh orders and about 3,300 official PDFs. Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu aren't done.

You removed the fixed date, so work goes in logical order: collect, ask, read, fix, then the next state. Checked this page against the code and corrected it: tests are 231, exact records and scan reading are shown, and stale document lists are gone. The older Version 1 tabs are kept as history and weren't checked.
